title: Cloud Management, Kubernetes and Pods
src: Source: Lecture 06 Part I Cloud Management and Software Deployment (29 slides) and Part II Kubernetes Pods, From Scratch (15 slides).
lead: Lectures 06 and 06.1: cloud management, software deployment, CaaS, resource provisioning and Infrastructure as Code, load balancing (application, network, global), auto-scaling, horizontal vs vertical scaling, Kubernetes architecture and objects, deployment, self-healing and rolling updates, Pods (analogy, anatomy, YAML, kubectl, sidecar, init containers, lifecycle, restart policies), and designing for resilience, flexibility and cost.
